annotations.title: 法人番号・T番号から会社情報を調べる

description: Look up one Japanese company or invoice issuer by its corporate number (法人番号, 13 digits) or invoice registration number (登録番号, 'T' + 13 digits). Hyphens, spaces and full-width digits are accepted, e.g. 「T1-1803-0101-8771」. Returns official name, kana, address, whether the company is still active (閉鎖の有無), and its invoice registration status (有効/失効/登録取消/未登録). T-numbers of sole proprietors (個人事業主) also work, but personal address is returned only if the person chose to publish it. If you only have a company name, call bango_find_company first. Uses 1 API request.

number.description: 法人番号（13桁）またはインボイス登録番号（T+13桁）

response_format.description: concise（既定）は要点だけ。detailed はAPIの全項目（英語名、変更履歴など）も含める

name: bango_get_company
